lockFileMaintenance.description: Weekly, beside the non-major group: refresh every lockfile within its ranges, so transitive dependencies (where most security alerts sit) move too

packageRules.description: Automerge minor and patch updates once checks pass; majors always wait for review
Update dev dependencies in a grouped PR

Every minor, patch, pin and digest update in one PR a week: one PR's checks instead of one per dependency (each PR's macOS jobs queue for hours on free runners). Security updates keep their own PRs, at once
Bump GitHub Actions majors together; they track the runner's Node runtime
At most 3 majors open at once: Renovate opens a major only while fewer than 3 of its PRs are open, so minor and patch updates go first
